name: @red-cup-engineering/parlor-service-561-group
description: parlor.561.group — the five-game parlor shelf, one service, built on @red-cup-engineering/parlor-kernel per the mesh-not-monolith doctrine (games as data plus a thin face, not five separate reimplementations). The dice trio: Pig (hold-or-roll, first to 100), Farkle (dice-set scoring, hot dice, bust), and Yacht (5 dice, 3 rolls, 13 categories) — every decision surfaces the kernel's own computed bust odds and expected values, live, not asserted; Pig and Farkle ship a bot opponent that plays the published math. Chutes & Ladders: the classic 100-square race as a board-as-graph (a chute and a ladder are one jump edge), 1-4 players including bots — the bot IS a die, there is no strategy in this game — with the live exact probability distribution of finish turns computed and shown as the race runs. Fair Spin: a 3-reel practice slot that inverts the genre — computed RTP, per-symbol hit odds, and expected loss per 100 spins are shown permanently, never behind a click. Daily-seeded (today's dice/race/spins identical for everyone who hasn't started their own run). Earn-only, no wagering, kind design.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit --noCheck --allowImportingTsExtensions --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target esnext src/games/*/*.mts web/test/*.test.mts && for f in worker.mjs web/js/*.mjs web/server.mjs; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
